title: albuca exigua

The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as potential anti-cancer and antimicrobial effects. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
